build.command:
set -eu
src=emqx-src
pkg=emqx630-candidate/emqx-enterprise-6.3.0-debian-loongarch64.tar.gz
expected=fbf1f7a2df89598fc21b0ad0ba63de0677d28cd54f62f3283221286e7b43d48d
actual=$(sha256sum "$pkg" | cut -d ' ' -f1)
test "$actual" = "$expected"
test "$(sha256sum "$src/emqx-enterprise-6.3.0-debian13-loong64.tar.gz" | cut -d ' ' -f1)" = "$expected"
docker buildx build --load --progress=plain --platform linux/loong64 \
  --build-arg BUILD_FROM=lcr.loongnix.cn/library/debian:14-slim \
  --build-arg RUN_FROM=lcr.loongnix.cn/library/debian:14-slim \
  --build-arg SOURCE_TYPE=tgz \
  --build-arg PROFILE=emqx-enterprise \
  --build-arg PKG_VSN=6.3.0 \
  -t emqx-enterprise:6.3.0-loong64-debian14 \
  -f "$src/deploy/docker/Dockerfile" "$src"

environment.helper: native LoongArch64 Debian helper based on the requested Debian 14 slim image
environment.network: BCLA direct=true; standard helper proxy overlay masked

tests.command:
set -eu
img=emqx-enterprise:6.3.0-loong64-debian14
docker image inspect --format 'ID={{.Id}} OS={{.Os}} ARCH={{.Architecture}} USER={{.Config.User}} ENTRYPOINT={{json .Config.Entrypoint}} CMD={{json .Config.Cmd}} ENV={{json .Config.Env}}' "$img"
docker run --rm --platform linux/loong64 --entrypoint /opt/emqx/bin/emqx "$img" check_config

set -eu
img=emqx-enterprise:6.3.0-loong64-debian14
name="bcla-emqx630-smoke-$$"
cleanup() { docker rm -f "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT
docker run -d --platform linux/loong64 --name "$name" "$img"
i=0
until [ "$i" -ge 45 ]; do
  state=$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Status}}' "$name")
  if [ "$state" != running ]; then
    docker logs "$name"
    echo "container stopped before ready: $state" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  if docker exec "$name" /opt/emqx/bin/emqx ping; then
    echo "DEFAULT_ENTRYPOINT_STARTUP=PASS"
    docker logs "$name" 2>&1 | tail -n 30
    exit 0
  fi
  i=$((i + 1))
  sleep 2
done
docker logs "$name"
echo "EMQX ping readiness timeout" >&2
exit 1

dependencies.name: EMQX Enterprise distribution
dependencies.abi: Debian-family glibc; native LoongArch64 EMQX/OTP runtime
dependencies.consumer: upstream Dockerfile builder_tgz stage, then final /opt/emqx

dependencies.name: stunnel static curl
dependencies.consumer: temporary curl_static stage; verified curl binary copied to final /usr/bin/curl

environment_assumptions: Native LoongArch64 Docker daemon with Docker Buildx
Direct access to deb.debian.org and GitHub release assets
The requested Debian base tag/digest remains available
Debian package repositories are unpinned in the upstream Dockerfile; package layer contents can change over time
applicability.runtime: Official /usr/bin/docker-entrypoint.sh and /opt/emqx/bin/emqx foreground command; runtime user emqx.
